Elena: Quick exec note — short and operational this week. TL;DR: stability gains so far, cost pilot is promising, a few tactical asks below. Please scan and act where relevant. :rocket:

Key metrics (last 7 days):
- Uptime: 99.982% (down 18m of downtime, root cause traced to a single autoscaler regression)
- p95 gen latency: 420ms -> 370ms after runtime patch (approx -12%)
- Infra unit cost per 1k tokens: down 8% in pilot clusters (batching + int8 quantization)
- New MRR (hosted + dedicated deals): +6% MoM; two Dedicated POCs moved to legal

Top priorities this week (exec owned):
1) EU region stability — Jon + infra to finalize hotfix rollout + postmortem. Expect canary today, full roll 24h after green.
2) Dedicated billing changes — Finance & Product (Kyle) to finalize pricing cadence; legal to sign off on two pipeline deals.
3) Private beta for VPC/on-prem — Ops (Maria) to validate install runbook and support playbook before soft launch next Tue.
4) Cost pilot rollout — infra to expand quantized runtime to 3 more pools; measure quality regressions on our eval set and report by Thu.

Risks / open asks:
- KV cache tail-latency spike persists under a small traffic pattern. Jon: please prioritize an isolation test and revert path.
- Support SLAs: we need a clear on-call rotation for Dedicated customers; Kyle + Maria to propose by EOD Fri.

Hiring & org: approved headcount for 6 hires this quarter (infra, SRE, and product). Recruiting: prioritize infra engineers with inference-runtime experience.

Meetings / calls: exec sync Wed 10:00 PT; demo of private beta Thurs 11:00 PT.

Thanks all — quick ask: if you own any of the 4 priorities above, drop a one-line update here with ETA.

Maria: On EU stability & private beta — will run canary for EU hotfix at 15:00 PT, monitor for 3 hours. For VPC beta, we finished acceptance tests; scheduling two customer installs next week. ETA for beta launch is Tue EOD.

Jon: Re KV cache — I've got a repro and a debug branch. Planning a canary revert if we see >5ms tail spike at 10% traffic. Also will post logs to the incident channel.

Kyle: Billing — finalizing pricing table today, will share a one-pager in #product. Regarding SLA rota, Maria + I will propose a weekly rotation and escalation map by Friday.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: EU hotfix canary scheduled at 2026-03-23T15:00:00Z. Notifying infra-oncall.

Elena: Appreciate the quick turn. One governance note — any rollout that touches Dedicated customers requires a release note and a single test customer signoff. Maria/Jon, please confirm you have that covered.

Maria: Confirmed — we have one Dedicated customer on standby for the hotfix signoff.

Jon: Will follow release note checklist and ping legal for the Dedicated signoff form.

Elena: Great. Closing loop — focus on stability first, keep cost pilot scoped, and let's not rush the private beta docs. Short updates in this thread suffice. :thumbsup:
